verdict.rationale: Glama documents hosting and deployment through connecting a GitHub repository and configuring builds, plus copy-paste config blocks for installing servers into clients. Nothing in the evidence describes an official CLI that authenticates, builds, pushes, or installs servers. The mcp-proxy mention is a tunnel for testing local servers in the inspector, not a publish-and-deploy CLI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
